one-board-for-all-deals.title: One board for all deals
one-board-for-all-deals.keywords: one place, one note per deal, five columns, company and value, total on top
one-board-for-all-deals.script: Now you need one place for all your deals. Draw a board. Each deal is one note, and each note sits in one column: lead in, contact made, needs defined, proposal made, negotiations started. The company name and the value are on the note. The total sits on top of each column. You see your whole pipeline at a glance.

fourth-actionable-track-deals.title: Fourth actionable, track deals
fourth-actionable-track-deals.keywords: simple pipeline, spreadsheet or free tool, current not clever, measure it
fourth-actionable-track-deals.script: Here is your fourth task. Track every deal in a simple pipeline. Start with a spreadsheet or a free tool. It does not need to be clever. It needs to be current. Then you can measure it, and we come to that in a minute.

move-or-drop.title: Move or drop
move-or-drop.keywords: one note moves, do not hope, decide, push forward or drop
move-or-drop.script: Watch one note move from one column to the next. That is what you want. If a deal does not move, you do not hope. You decide. Push it forward, or drop it and free your attention.
